name: soldier
equipment: Bone dice or deck of cards

feature.name: military rank
desc: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former organization still recognize your authority.

lore:
The Soldier is a creature of hardened utility, forged in the crucible of statecraft and strife. They are most commonly observed in the borderlands or the shadowed corners of bustling garrisons, distinguished by a gait that retains the rhythmic cadence of the march even in repose. Their "ecology" is one of structured survival; they treat the wilderness not as a wonder, but as a series of tactical advantages and sightlines.

Behaviorally, the Soldier is defined by a vigilant restlessness. Their eyes seldom linger on a face, instead scanning for the glint of concealed steel or the nearest exit. They possess a peculiar affinity for routine—the rhythmic scrape of a whetstone or the meticulous oiling of leather serves as a meditative balm against the ghosts of the front. Though they may shed their tabard, the iron of the soul remains, manifesting as a fierce, quiet loyalty to the squad they now call kin.
